_doc: WHEN each CFTC Commitments of Traders report became PUBLIC, where it was not the normal rule. The normal rule (cot_release.py): released the Friday after the as-of Tuesday at 15:30 ET; a federal holiday or closure on the Wednesday, Thursday or Friday of that week moves the release to the next federal publication day (CFTC's own 2026 schedule: Jan 5, Jun 22, Jul 6, Nov 16, Nov 30, Dec 28 are all such Mondays; a TUESDAY holiday does not move it: as-of Mon 2025-11-10 was scheduled Fri 2025-11-14). The cot_records store keeps only the as-of date, so these are the authoritative exceptions. Every entry is on the LATE side: a chart or formula may see a report late, never early.

overrides.source: CFTC PR 9138-25 (resume 2025-11-19, chronological) and PR 9147-25 (accelerated schedule table; normal schedule from the 2025-12-23 report)

CFTC PR 7864-19: first catch-up report (as-of 2018-12-24) published Friday 2019-02-01, then 'one report on Tuesday and another on Friday of each week' in chronological order until current. Applied to the store's as-of dates, the sequence meets the normal schedule at the as-of 2019-03-05 report (Friday 2019-03-08).

bounds.source: CFTC PR 8662-23 and COT Historical Special Announcements: the ION cyber incident delayed every report from the one due Friday 2023-02-03 (as-of 2023-01-31); catch-up publications ran from 2023-02-24 with the last delayed publications announced through 2023-03-21. Every delayed report is therefore placed at the END of 2023-03-21 ET.
